description: No spinner glyph found in the buffer (e.g. spinner scrolled offscreen, or a future CC version uses a glyph we don't recognize), but a paren-wrapped seconds counter advanced from 5 to 6 since the prior tick. The classifier returns thinking-active on the strength of the counter alone — independent fallback to glyph rotation. Without this rescue, this case would return 'unknown' and the upstream hook's no-spinner-20s timer would eventually escalate to 'stuck' on a healthy turn.
